classes.3: intentional special mechanic, needs Tyler's explicit approval

formulas.owner: combat owns the expression. Progression owns what a skill level is worth
formulas.what: A hero's largest blow (maxHit): floor(0.35 x (weapon skill + worn +skill) + 0.6 x summed damage bonus + 2), then x the weakness factor, then x (1 + damage buff). Never under 1
A hero's chance to land a basic blow: ratio(20 + skill + worn accuracy, the monster's evasion) x 1.15 on a weak-weapon match, held to 5%..97%. Steady then turns a share of the misses into hits

formulas.owner: combat owns the blow, and a dry shot at x0.25 (src/core/ammo.js AMMO_DRY_MULT) is a multiplier on it that the combat inventory missed. Economy owns the bill
formulas.what: One basic blow: miss is 0, a hit is a whole number 1..maxHit with equal odds (mean (maxHit + 1) / 2)

Critical basic blows: chance = clamp(gear critB + crit buff + set bonus + Keen, 0, 0.60). A crit is max(damage + 1, floor(damage x 1.5)). The set bonus is 1% a tier for 5+ armor pieces of one tier and line
The damage factor against one monster: weapon weakness 1.20 x bane (at most 1.40) x weapon element (at most 1.15), the product held to 1.90. A weapon match also gives x1.15 accuracy

Every amount that lands on a unit, in this order. On a monster: x element (a weakness at the tag's weakPm share) then minus the defence cut, x the cast's power (version, store, surge, mark), x the boss guard, x the dealer's stance, x the target's stance, at least 1, x Tempering. On a hero: x power, x stances, then the armor chain. Then the spell shell, then HP
A monster's defence: floor(def x 0.03) whole points off every blow and every tick it takes
What an element is worth on a monster: 1000 - 10 x its profile's percent, the percent held to ELEMENT_PCT. A row with weakPm lands only that share of a weakness
A target that takes more: Hunter's Mark (unit fields markPm until markUntil) plus the strongest marking status (takenPm), added and folded into the cast's power
Stance: Offensive deals and takes x1.10, Defensive deals x0.90 and takes x0.85

formulas.owner: combat lands the rung. Economy prices it (E38)
formulas.what: Tempering: Blows raises what lands on a monster and every heal by rungs x the ladder's permille. Armor (with worn steadyPm and a food's steady) lowers what reaches the hero, last, never past the cap. The part of a point is a chance

formulas.owner: combat owns what a cast lands (also C-SPELL-HEAL, C-SPELL-SHELL, C-CAST-POWER). Progression owns what it trains
formulas.what: A damaging cast: each hit rolls a whole number from max(ceil(top / 2), base lo) to max(top, base hi), top = floor(maxHit x hitPm / 1000). Then C-HURT. It never misses and never crits
A heal: floor(max(floor(maxHit x healPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), whole (no roll), x Tempering, less the heal cut, capped at missing HP. Mend alone: floor(maxHp x 110 / 1000) x power

A shell: floor(max(floor(maxHit x shieldPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), a pool that a blow spends before HP. A recast of a self shell refunds the unused part as mana. A party shell never lowers a bigger one
A cast's power in permille: the rune tier's step (1000 / 1100 / 1200 / 1300 / 1400 at each tier's skill gate, runes.js versionLevel) x the store's share for a store rune x Surge when it surges

Statuses, one generic engine: a ticking one (Bleed: scale = max(tier share, floor(maxHit x 33 x tier share / 1000)), tick = round(roll 1..3 x scale / 1000) a stack a second, 5 stacks, 6 s), a marking one (takenPm), a slowing one (Chill: clock x (1000 + slowPm) / 1000, 30% to 50% by rune tier), a heal-cutting one (Withered)
Every heal a Withered unit takes: n - floor(n x cut / 1000). A hero 30% (less by its necrotic resistance), a monster 50%
Life leech: floor(HP a hit took x leechPm / 1000) back to the caster (Reave 300). Mana back: min(mana spent, hits x manaPerHit + kills x manaPerKill). Focus: a kill returns focusPm of max mana

Attack speed: every basic attack is 2,000 ms for heroes and monsters with no speed modifier. A cast locks its lane (offense 2 s, support 2 s, heal 1 s) and its own cooldown. Chill stretches a swing and a windup
Mana: regenerates 25% of max a minute x the Inner Flame rate. A caster's basic costs 1 mana. A cast costs its version's mana, never more with level

formulas.owner: combat owns regeneration. Progression owns the Inner Flame level it reads
formulas.what: HP regeneration: 0.3% of max a second in a fight and 6% out of one, x the Inner Flame rate 1 + P / (P + 50). The fist wraps add selfHealPm a second
A monster's largest blow: floor(atk x the art tier's scale), scale 5.4 for tiers 1-2, 4.0 for 3-4, 3.0 for 5, 2.2 for 6. It rolls 1..that like a hero's
A monster's chance to land: ratio(aim, 20 + Defense + worn +Defense + guard), held to 5%..97%. Guard is the defB of gear outside the armor weights (a shield, a cape)

What armor does to a landed blow, in fixed order: dodge (medium) = floor(650 x P / (P + 0.4 x L)), absorb (heavy) = floor(750 x P / (P + 0.62 x L)), the resistance, ward (light) = floor(P x 1.5) flat, Tempering, and never more than 60% in all. L is the ATTACKER's Level, with the tier's dial on it
A hero's resistance: taken = 1000 - min(cap, summed worn resistPm), cap 40% an element and 10% physical. Storm also burns mana for half the HP it took. Necrotic lands Withered

formulas.owner: combat owns the HP line. XP and coin are priced per HP point on the same row, so a change to it is an XP and coin change the same day
formulas.what: A monster row from its Level, role, ground floor and fit: HP = (4.95 + 1.76 x L) x role x fit, blow = a share (13.2% to 22%) of a same-Level hero's base HP, aim and evasion from the reference hero (lands 70%, is landed on 85%), def = 0.08 x L x role

formulas.owner: progression computes the career. Combat reads it. Past Level 1,000 its straight line overstates skill (375 at 5,000 against about 248): quote the played numbers of 42 section 7.2
formulas.what: The reference hero a monster is written against: a measured career (the lone hammer) [Level, skill, Defense, worn accuracy] every 5 Levels to 100, sparser to 1,000, straight past it. aimFor and evasionFor invert the ratio

formulas.owner: one table, three readers: combat the damage and Level half, progression the XP dial, economy the pull as kill rate
formulas.what: Normal, Dangerous, Deadly: a pull size and three dials. dmgPm multiplies atk, aim AND the monster's Level as armor reads it. hpPm its HP. xpPm its kill XP. On a gentle ground the tier first takes back the ground's kindness, so its dmgPm is solved per floor

A monster's spell: it rolls from half to all of floor(its largest blow x hitPm / 1000), then the hero's armor as any blow. A worn shield takes 30% off a marked spell. A mend puts the same roll back on a packmate. The first cast waits a random share of the cooldown

A boss's two lines on his HP: adds arrive at addsPm and he takes only guardPm of every blow while one stands. Under enragePm his atk and aim are x enrageAtkPm, and one named spell's cooldown is x cdPm

A boss room: one fight, a time limit, his kill ends it, nothing resets. A called room pays nothing. A keyed hall pays as a ground. A boss is the formula's boss role: HP x5, blow x1.1 held to 33% of the FLOOR hero's HP

formulas.owner: combat owns a floor's monsters. Progression owns what a floor pays
formulas.what: A Burning Tower floor or a Catacomb room F: 5 monsters, each the stat formula at Level F on a floor-F ground, a Keeper (boss role) every 10th. Past floor 100 every blow is x1.012 a floor, compounding. Floor 300 is the last row

Aggro is rules, not threat numbers: a pack turns on the pull's leader. Challenge takes every monster within 6 tiles that is not on a tank and holds it 8 s. A Healer's basic draws a free monster 18% of the time. A shooter aims at the hero farthest back. A tank under 90% of the strongest tank's HP never takes a turn

Area and extra targets: a shape (the 3x3, a line of len, a ring of r) hits every engaged monster it covers for the FULL roll each, up to maxHits. Follow-through repeats a basic blow on one neighbour. An area arrow hits its footprint
A pack lives in its room plus a margin (1 tile unless the ground says more). If the aggro holder leaves, the pack resets and heals. A called or keyed boss never resets

formulas.owner: combat owns how many stand. Economy reads it as kill rate
formulas.what: How many stand in a fight: the ground's packs on Normal, the tier's pull on a harder tier (8, the Glade's Dangerous 6, none under floor 16). A monster's HP is its row's x hpPm for every party size

Armor points: the one gear formula (src/core/gear-stats.js gearStats): the weight's profile (plate 1000, leather 550, cloth 300 permille) x the slot's share (GEAR_SLOT_PM) x the defense budget at the piece's item Level, each line's trades a share of the same budget, a named piece its statPlus; on a Danger-scale ground read at the ground's base item Level (scaleItems). Past tier 7 the staged line is Dawnsteel x max(1, Level / 110), and each unique is hand-sized under it

formulas.owner: combat owns what a piece carries (also C-GEAR-ARMOR). Progression owns the Level it is worn at (P35)
formulas.what: Weapon accuracy and damage: the one gear formula, the family's profile x the slot's share (a two-handed weapon the shield's too) x the offense budget at the piece's item Level; on a Danger-scale ground read at the ground's base item Level. Past tier 7 the staged line is Dawnsteel x max(1, Level / 110)

formulas.owner: combat lands the perk. Economy prices the Hallmark (E40)
formulas.what: Worn modifiers and how each stacks: jewel perks (Keen, Steady, Follow, Surge, Focus) count the largest once. Resistance sums, then caps. +skill sums. The own heal takes the largest. critB sums
The injected bonus reader: a food buff or a perk adds to damage, crit and steady (a damage cut). Permanent perks are held to 20%
The training yard's dummy: its blow never takes a hero under a floor, and it never falls
Level curve: total Level XP to reach a Level, and the Level a total makes
Pace contract: the Level XP an hour a ground must pay at its own Level: 1385 x L^1.274
Combat skill curve: XP from skill level s to s+1 = floor(15 x s^2 x 1.04^(s-1)), no cap
Capped skill table: gathering and crafting levels 1 to 99 from a 99-row XP table
Skill XP grant: credited XP = floor(carry + base x (1 + allXP + combatXP)), base = amount x 0.39 unless the skill is exempt (the rested quantum is gone: P30 cut 2026-11-21)

formulas.owner: progression owns the three skill XP routes (P06, P07, P08)
formulas.what: Weapon skill XP from a blow: Melee or Ranged XP = damage dealt x 1.5
Defense XP from a monster's blow: 0.2 x the attacker's Level (raised by the tier's damage dial) per blow aimed at an armored hero, x2 when a shield turns it
Magic XP from a cast: floor(mana spent x 1.5 x the ability's multiplier)
Training pay: 30,000 skill XP a settled hour for any skill at any level, 200% while a training item's hours last
Max HP and max mana: HP = floor((150 + 10 x (L-1)) x (1000 + 280 x heavy slots / 6) / 1000); mana the same with 100, 10 and 350 x light slots / 6
+skill on worn gear: a worn piece's meleePlus / rangedPlus / magicPlus / defensePlus adds whole skill levels wherever a fight reads the skill
Special attributes and chest gear: one attribute a piece at a size by gear tier, with a cap across everything worn

formulas.owner: progression owns the split
formulas.what: Kill XP split: hero Level XP = floor(kill XP x mode share / living heroes x party factor / 1000 x scaled-hunt party share x the hero's own multiplier x the under-floor share)

formulas.owner: progression owns the party table
formulas.what: Party class table: permille of a kill shared by the living heroes, by party size and classes held; a hero alone 1150

Run ground pay: a Tower kill pays each hero the hours table's share of its own Level over refKillsHead x the depth ratio at the floor's gap x payPm x the room's share, split evenly (lane/tower-boss-formula)

formulas.owner: progression owns the under-floor share
formulas.what: Under-floor Level share: a seat under the ground's floor AND under 66.7% of the party's top Level keeps floor(1000 x (Level / (top x 0.667))^2) permille of its share

formulas.owner: progression owns the mode share
formulas.what: Session mode share: the Tower and the Catacombs pay 37.5% of a kill's Level XP and a death there costs nothing
XP weekend: +25% Level XP a kill for 72 hours every 14 days; live rows add, never past +50%
Death cost: Level XP lost = floor(total Level XP x 0.06 x the mode's share); each combat skill loses floor(0.06 x its progress into its level)

Rested bank: CUT 2026-11-21 (FB-2, 1040-rested-bank-cut.sql; the sitting S-9 C): no rested bank. It was one charge every 6 minutes to a cap of 80 (120 with the Library), a spent charge a flat quantum of at most 1,600 XP

Perk XP channels: allXP and combatXP sum from rooms, renown, buffs and a companion; permanent sources are held to +20%; a companion's bonus = base x (1 + 0.05 x (level - 1)) and is added after the cap
Gear worn by Level: every piece of equipment names a hero Level as its requirement
Skill lines (simulator projection): the skills the balance simulator gives a hero at a Level; past the measured line a straight line on its last ten Levels

formulas.owner: hunting owns XP a kill. Progression reads it as an input
formulas.what: Level XP one kill pays: max(min, a x L^b) x HP x role.xp x fit.xp x groundXpFit x floorFit
Which monsters a pull spawns: the pocket's authored rows, then its non-boss fill rows round again up to the density
A cleared pack is back ground.respawnMs after it was cleared, never mid-fight
The time between pulls: travel at hero speed, regroup at least 1.5 s within 7 tiles, out-of-combat regen 6% of max HP a second
XP an hour, kills an hour and gold an hour. No formula computes these. The target is contractXpPerH = 1385 x L^1.274 and the engine is the only reader of the real value
A trophy find's odds: oneIn = round(actions an hour x authored hours). Nothing scales it
Hunting spends one ms of stamina a ms hunted. The bar holds 8 h free, 12 h Premium
ceil((base + perLevel x L) x (stepDen + stepNum x (n-1)) x minutes / (stepDen x 240)). Six a day, 4 h each at most
What a hunt spends on supplies: own stock first, then store units at the catalogue's unit price, down to the hero's gold floor
When a heal, a mana draught or a buff is used, and its cooldown
Coin a kill: mean = 0.30 x line x HP x role.gp x fitGp x groundGpFit, rolled lo..2 x mean - lo so the mean holds
floor(share x (1 + max(0, goldFind))) on monster coin only
A kill's coin split evenly, the remainder one coin each from a seat that moves with the kill
What the shop pays: book x gear rate (by tier), x0.20 if raw, x the ground's income dial, never under its lower-tier twin where the dial put it there, never over half the cheapest shop price
The share of book value worn gear sells for, by tier, with one carve-out for tier-2 hourly armor
A drop sells at the highest income dial of the grounds that drop it. Anything also gathered or crafted is exempt
The cheapest gold price of one unit of each item across single-line shop offers
A shop offer's price: an authored row. The listed gear, tools and seeds sell at 2 x book
An imbuement part's book value: 2 gold a monster Level. Its tier: 1, 2 or 3 at Levels 1, 30, 80
Listing fee = max(fee_min, ceil(qty x ask x 1%)). The house takes ceil(gross x 1.5%). Floor = the shop's bid. Ceiling = max(ceiling_min, book x 100)
A public bench takes 15% of what a job's output sells for, in milligold with a carry, free under half a gold
round(3000 x 1.32^k), ten rungs
A town sink's price: the n-th of its price row today, or base + perLevel x Level

formulas.owner: economy owns the price. Progression owns what a death costs
formulas.what: 0 under Level 30, else base + perLevel x (Level - 30). Three tiers cut a death's XP loss 25, 50, 75%
Five rungs a track a gear tier, each doubling in gold, each worth 1% (0.4% on tier 7), plus crafted salts
The Weighhouse's goal: max(250,000, 20,000 x weekly active accounts). A gift is 100 at least, 25,000 a day at most

formulas.owner: economy owns the fee
formulas.what: The public yard's fee: ruled 100 gold x skill level an hour
Property, room, storage chest and curing slot prices: hand-typed ladders
min(0.95, ch x monster dropBonus x (1 + dropRate buff) x featured). A row at 100% is untouched
One roll a row a kill. On a scaled hour, ceil(lootPm / 1000) rolls of chance x lootPm / 1000 / k
A row's promise in hours a piece a hero at the ground's floor. Each row's ch is typed by hand until the test's measured hours land in the band
Who takes a Rare or Trophy unit: highest of 1..100 among heroes who have not won since everyone last did
One roll over the boss's rows as slices of 1. A hero's first roll ever fills the empty part onto the rows marked first
min(1, weaponPm x warmth x stoke): warmth +4% a dry key up to x3, stokes x1.7 / 2.5 / 3.3 for 3 / 7 / 12 keys of Cinders
Charm x trophy drop multiplier capped at 1.07, and a boss relic multiplier up to 1.25
Boss of the day x1.5 drops and x1.25 XP, weekly x2.0 and x1.5
A bounty's kill count and reward, in SQL only

formulas.owner: economy owns the Luck bar, unbuilt
formulas.what: Account Luck: rank n costs 100 x n^2. One Magic Find budget of 104 a hero. Past Krell, Rare rows 15% rarer at band 8 to 25% at band 18
A lining: one monster part + gold, cured 4 h in a House slot, lasts 12 hunted hours, stacks to 48 h a socket. Effects: an element guard (Stitched 20%, Sealed 30%, capped 40% with gear) or a leech
Gold in and gold out an account-day at 12 h: 48 hero-hours x (coin + sold loot) minus store supplies, refills, taxes and bought sinks

class3.why: The boss cap should bound his spell, not his attack. Then his row is the formula's and the named exception goes
One early-game curve for every ground under Level 16. Gentle first grounds are right. Document it as the only Level threshold in monster stats
Keep "built for a party" as one encounter type with three numbers (HP, blow, XP). Remove its three inner patches. 53-review-world asks to remove the whole type: the matrix decides between them
It contradicts the 2026-11-07 ruling that harder tiers keep the bigger pulls. Its cause is kill reward with no kill-rate term, which the kill reward formula fixes
A content flag on the tutorial ground. It changes no formula
Keep the effect you ruled. Replace 17 per-row floors with one number: a cast never reads a hit under N
The second of two heal kinds, a share of max HP. It is the one heal that never falls behind at high Level
One roll rule with the spread as one number a kind of amount: swings, spell hits, heals. Three rows of one rule
One shared gate read from data. Tank spells are party only by your ruling
Make it a stat on the shield row, so a future shield can carry more or less of it. No rule keyed on a slot
Storm burning mana and Necrotic cutting heals are what make the two elements different. The numbers need your yes before the switch goes on
Rounding by chance is the right idea. Use it once, at the end of the one amount pipeline, for every blow. Then small bonuses pay at low Level everywhere
A boss must not one-shot the hero his ground is written for. Keep it as a bound in the monster formula and it needs your yes
A called fight is practice and a keyed hall is the reward. Two rows of one room mechanic
The training yard needs a target that cannot kill or die
A basic attack costs by weapon. It is the supply identity of each way of fighting
Fold the +15% into the base of the one party table as its first cell. The number stays. One constant less
The Tower takes the one party table. Your 2026-11-16 words were one table and not a unique formula everywhere
The Tower trades XP for a free death. It is one row of the mode table
Keep the Catacombs on the mode table. Its copied numbers stay marked ASSUMED until the matrix plays them
Level XP loses a share of the total and a skill a share of its progress. Take Inner Flame off the list: it is trained at the Hearth, not in a fight
Free under Level 30 falls out of a price that follows the hours a Blessing saves. Early deaths cost minutes, so the price is near zero with no threshold
One fixed rate makes the yard worthless near skill 100. Pay a share of the skill level's cost. This changes a ruling, so it is your call
A rung is worth less on stronger gear. Make the rung size one line by gear Level, so the next band needs no new hand number
Starter gear has no Tempering. A content flag
Boss gems fix one thing about a jewelry roll. A content rule on the craft, not a combat formula
A flat +4 skill is about 1.4 damage at any Level, and you asked for major upgrades. Make it a percent of the blow
Melee trains on damage dealt, Magic on mana spent, Defense on blows taken. Three bases for three different jobs. It needs your yes on record
Events add and never pass +50%. One line of the XP chain
The coin line that climbs from x0.5 to x1.4 over the first grounds is one of four stacked coin dials. Fold all four into one coin line by monster Level
A hero's first hall roll always lands. A good first-time moment
Chest warmth and stokes are the pity rule. Bounded by construction
The parts wait for linings. Nothing planned is cut. When linings land, part value becomes one line by monster Level with no steps
